verdict.rationale: The docs describe a data-in, UI-out model: components receive data and return what should appear, and React re-renders when new data is passed in response to interactions. React Developer Tools let developers inspect and edit props and state, which supports tracing state changes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-way/unidirectional data flow, any contrast with two-way binding, guidance on lifting state or tracing updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
